faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the PAU Senior Research Fellow position is 05-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Sc. or B.Sc. (Agriculture) with a minimum OCPA of 6.00/10.00 or 60% marks. Additionally, an M.Sc. in Soil Science, Chemistry, or Botany with a minimum OCPA of 6.50/10.00 or 65% marks is required, and M.Sc. candidates must have qualified NET.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37000/- per month, plus HRA, on a fixed basis.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with necessary documents to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Fellow position will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted and called for an interview based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 200/- for General/OBC and SC/ST categories. Please refer to the official notification for payment details.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Senior Research Fellow in this recruitment drive by Punjab Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Punjab Agricultural University located?
faq.answer: Punjab Agricultural University is located in Ludhiana, Punjab, with the pincode 141004.

faq.question: Q9. What is the interview date for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Senior Research Fellow position is scheduled to be held on 09-10-2026.

faq.question: Q10. Does the university offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation for reserved categories is not explicitly detailed here. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for specific details on age relaxation policies.
